Triage: first-touch graded — promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` as a small hygiene Task. (Triage seat, session `session_0185aJyu6TRnHbcVgSfGPSho`.)

Rationale: not user-visible today (PR #5175 removed the consumer leg and added the dev diagnostic; strict spec rejects such metadata at the door), but the producer still emits a key the declaration (`FlatMapConfigKeys = Omit<ObjectMapConfig, 'style'>`) explicitly excludes — declaration/production drift that decays into a trap. Disposition: the card's option 1 — flatten through a `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` whitelist instead of the whole-bag spread, in both `ObjectView.tsx` and `ListView.tsx`, so declared = produced and a new key must enter the declaration to travel. ⛔ Option 2 (rename-translate) adds a second convention; option 3 (block forwarding) only covers ListView per #5042's scope, so it cannot close this alone.

Serial constraint for dispatch: both files sit in #5042's hot zone — name #5042 in the claim's serial-constraints line and serialize if it is in flight.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: sonnet` — triage graded it a small hygiene Task and named the disposition; correctness is decided by a key list, not by design judgement. ⬆️ Escalate to `opus` and say so if the whitelist turns out to need a shape the declaration cannot express.
Clause-②: no — this **narrows** what an internal transport form emits, to match a declaration that already excludes the key. Nothing published widens; the strict spec never accepted this metadata at all.
Serial constraints cleared: **#5042 named explicitly per triage's instruction** — both files sit in its hot zone. #5042 is **pin-suspended and not in flight** (lockfile still measures `17.0.0-rc.2`), so there is no in-flight sibling to serialize behind. If #5042 is dispatched while you are running, I will handle the ordering — ⛔ do not merge around it yourself. `packages/plugin-view` and `packages/plugin-list` are otherwise free; no open PR touches them.

## Zone 1 — Triage's ruling (binding)

**Option 1**: flatten through a `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` whitelist instead of the whole-bag spread, in **both** `ObjectView.tsx` and `ListView.tsx`, so declared = produced and a new key must enter the declaration in order to travel.

Both alternatives were considered and rejected, so ⛔ do not re-open them:
- **Option 2** (translate `map.style` → top-level `mapStyle`) adds a second convention.
- **Option 3** (forward the `map` block whole) only covers `ListView` under #5042's scope, so it cannot close this alone.

## The defect in one line

`...(viewOptions.map || {})` spreads an **untyped** bag (`NamedListView.options?: Record<string, any>`) to the top level, so whatever an author writes in the `map` block lands as a top-level key — while `FlatMapConfigKeys = Omit<ObjectMapConfig, 'style'>` **declares `style` out of the flat form**. Declaration and production disagree about the same thing.

`style` is the live specimen precisely because it is *also* `BaseSchema.style` (an inline-CSS record, legal on every node). The spread collapses two namespaces onto one key.

## Zone 2 — why this is hygiene and not urgency, stated so you scope it right

Nothing a user hits today: PR #5175 removed the consumer leg and added a dev diagnostic naming the correct spelling, and the pinned strict `ListViewSchema` / `ObjectListViewSchema` reject such metadata at the door — they have no `map` block, no `options` key, and do not accept `type: 'map'` at all. **So do not widen this into a user-facing repair.** The job is closing declaration/production drift before it decays into a trap.

Worth knowing while you choose the key list: the spec-side block coming in #5042 (`ListMapConfigSchema`) is a **strict seven-key** shape — `latitudeField` / `longitudeField` / `locationField` / `titleField` / `descriptionField` / `zoom` / `center` — and it does **not** contain `style` either. So the whitelist you write should not be a surprise to that future block. ⛔ Do not implement #5042's forwarding here; just do not contradict it.

## PM mechanism assumption (verify)

I expect `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` should be **derived from the declaration** rather than hand-listed twice, so the two flatteners and the declared type cannot drift apart again — which is the whole point of the card. If the declaration's shape makes a single derived list impractical, say so and hand-list it **once**, shared by both call sites. ⛔ Two hand-maintained copies in two files would rebuild the defect in a new form.

## Tests

Pin, for **both** `ObjectView` and `ListView`: a declared key in the `map` block still reaches the flattened product; **`style` in the `map` block does NOT reach the top level**; and an arbitrary undeclared key does not either. The `style` case is the specimen the card measured, so it is the one that must be red before your change.

## Gates

Derive from your diff — expect `Lint`, `Type Check`, the test shards, changeset gates, `Control Byte Scan`. Changeset required (`@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, plus `@object-ui/plugin-map` if the declaration moves). Score `minor` and describe any behaviour narrowing in the body per AGENTS.md §版本号策略 — ⛔ never `major`.

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`, first line `Fixes #5177`. Push the branch early. Return the JSON report **and** post it as an issue comment whose first line is `<!-- os-dev-report -->`. Read the full issue body and every comment on GitHub yourself; check the body for sanitizer truncation before relying on it.
